goal: Reduce ClassInjector's UsingInstrumentation output coupling by extracting the jar-creation and injection logic into a new helper class so that UsingInstrumentation no longer directly depends on low-level I/O and jar APIs (remove direct usage of java.io.File, java.io.FileOutputStream, java.io.OutputStream, java.util.jar.JarOutputStream, java.util.jar.JarEntry, java.util.jar.JarFile, java.util.zip.ZipFile, java.io.IOException and direct Class.forName usage in injectRaw).

inputs: byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/dynamic/loading/ClassInjector.java::ClassInjector.UsingInstrumentation.redefineModule(Instrumentation, JavaModule, Set<JavaModule>, Map<String, Set<JavaModule>>, Map<String, Set<JavaModule>>, Set<Class<?>>, Map<Class<?>, List<Class<?>>>)
outputs: byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/dynamic/loading/ClassInjectorInstrumentationSupport.java::ClassInjectorInstrumentationSupport.redefineModule(Instrumentation, JavaModule, Set<JavaModule>, Map<String, Set<JavaModule>>, Map<String, Set<JavaModule>>, Set<Class<?>>, Map<Class<?>, List<Class<?>>>)
byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/dynamic/loading/ClassInjectorInstrumentationSupport.java::ClassInjectorInstrumentationSupport.Target (retains an enum proxy for injection target)
ops.details: Extract the low-level jar assembly, temporary file creation/deletion, JarOutputStream/JarEntry writing and JarFile injection steps from UsingInstrumentation.injectRaw and the module redefinition helper redefineModule into a new top-level helper class named ClassInjectorInstrumentationSupport in the same package. The helper will expose: (1) createJarAndInject(names, classFileLocator, folder, target, instrumentation, randomString) which performs the File/JarOutputStream/FileOutputStream/JarFile/ZipFile operations and returns Map<String,Class<?>>; (2) redefineModule(...) as a delegated wrapper for the module redefinition logic so UsingInstrumentation no longer imports or references the jar/io classes directly. The extraction moves the folder and randomString usages into the helper; UsingInstrumentation will retain a small delegating call to the helper. Keep the helper in the same package to allow package-private access if required.

Replace the body of UsingInstrumentation.injectRaw to delegate to the new helper's createJarAndInject method. Ensure the method signature and return type remain unchanged so external callers of UsingInstrumentation are unaffected. Update imports in UsingInstrumentation to remove direct imports for java.io.*, java.util.jar.*, java.util.zip.* that are now only required by the helper.

Add the necessary imports (File, FileOutputStream, OutputStream, JarEntry, JarFile, JarOutputStream, ZipFile, IOException, ClassNotFoundException, RandomString, Instrumentation) to the new helper class. Remove these imports from UsingInstrumentation after the extraction.
